visual.general_description: Color photograph of a large intact translucent cystic mass on a pale board over a dark metal rack.
visual.detailed_description: A large, oval, lobulated, thin-walled grey-white translucent cystic mass fills most of the image, resting on a pale cutting board placed over a dark metal grill. Its surface carries many branching red-pink vessels and irregular bright-red blood streaks, with a darker red-brown irregular cleft or tear along the upper left surface. At the right end are two rounded bulges whose walls are clear enough to show darker brown-grey contents inside, and a small round dark-edged opening or depression sits on the upper right surface. Red blood smears lie on the board at the bottom edge. The photograph is framed by white margins with a thin dark border. No ruler, scale, label, panel letter, arrow, hand or instrument is visible.

visual.general_description: Color photograph of a gloved hand opening a cystic specimen on a board so that brown fluid spills out.
visual.detailed_description: A hand in a white examination glove, with the forearm entering from the left, holds a small metallic instrument against the upper surface of a translucent, blood-streaked cystic specimen lying on a pale cutting board over a dark metal grill. A brown fluid streams from the opened upper part of the specimen across the board toward the upper right, where it pools on a yellow-tan board area. The cyst wall is thin, translucent grey-pink with red streaks and vessels, and a darker red cleft is visible on its left side. Small red smears lie on the board below. A small round cap-like container sits at the upper right corner on the rack. The photograph has white side margins and a thin dark border. No scale, text, label, arrow or panel letter is visible.

visual.general_description: Low-power light micrograph of a pink-purple stained section with a thin wall at the top and branching glandular structures.
visual.detailed_description: A pink and purple stained tissue section on a pale yellow-green background. A thin band of wall-like tissue runs along the top edge and rises to a slight peak at upper right. Below it, branching papillary or glandular frond-like structures with purple-pink cell layers extend into pale, lightly stained spaces that contain scattered small cells and debris. Thin pink septum-like bands cross the field diagonally, and several darker pink irregular fragments lie in the lower part. The image is framed by white margins with a thin dark border. No scale bar, text, label, arrow or panel letter is visible.
